name: Divination Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Detect Evil and Good; Mind Spike; Clairvoyance; Divination; Scrying. Reaction when a visible creature within 60 feet makes a D20 Test: give it Advantage or Disadvantage. Once per Long Rest; a Divination spell cast with a slot restores the use.

benefits.name: School Benefit
benefits.summary: Reaction when a visible creature within 60 feet makes a D20 Test: give it Advantage or Disadvantage. Once per Long Rest; a Divination spell cast with a slot restores the use.
benefits.text: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to give that roll Advantage or Disadvantage. Once per Long Rest; casting a Divination spell with a spell slot restores the use. In a fight it's off until you set it to Automatic in the class tab: it then gives Disadvantage to the first saving throw an enemy within range makes against your own spell.
benefits.policy_cost: Your Reaction, once per Long Rest
